import json, os, subprocess, sys
bad = []

def serial_guard():
    ancestors, pid = set(), os.getpid()
    while pid > 1:
        ancestors.add(pid)
        try:
            pid = int(open("/proc/%d/stat" % pid).read().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[1])
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
            break
    for name in filter(str.isdigit, os.listdir("/proc")):
        if int(name) in ancestors:
            continue
        try:
            argv = [part.decode() for part in open("/proc/%s/cmdline" % name, "rb").read().split(b"\0") if part]
            cwd = os.readlink("/proc/%s/cwd" % name)
        except OSError:
            continue
        if cwd == os.getcwd() and len(argv) > 1 and os.path.basename(argv[0]) in ("bash", "sh") and argv[1].endswith(("tools/fixtures_self_test.sh", "tools/validate.sh")):
            print("REFUSED (exit 4): process %s is already running %s in this tree" % (name, argv[1]))

serial_guard()
pins = json.load(open(".agent/contracts/109.json"))["design_notes"]["pinned_interface"]

      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'generator-deterministic' row names role 'Planner', expected its own role 'Generator'$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] PASS", r"^  vlib_profiles_cover_roles:"], VAL),
    ("silencing the new primitive's failure path removes the C15 FAIL; the old primitive still passes",
     ["--py-mutate", SWAP, "--py-mutate", ABLATION_MUTATE], 0,
     [r"^SUMMARY: 16 passed, 0 failed$", r"^\[C15\] PASS capability-profile-roles$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL", r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles:"], VAL),
    ("every row mapped to Orchestrator (an AGF-defined role) still fails: correspondence, not membership",
     ["--py-mutate", ALL_ORCH], 1,
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL capability-profile-roles$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'evaluator-adversarial' row names role 'Orchestrator', expected its own role 'Evaluator'$",
      r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles: profile 'planner-creative' row names role 'Orchestrator', expected its own role 'Planner'$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] PASS"], VAL),
    ("--payload is unaffected by the swapped mapping",

     [r"^SUMMARY \(payload mode\): 12 passed, 0 failed$"],
     [r"^\[C15\] FAIL", r"^  vlib_profiles_map_roles:"], VAL + ["--payload"]),
]

def one(case):
    name, mutations, rc, expects, forbids, command = case
    argv = SR + mutations + ["--expect-rc", str(rc)]

        argv += ["--expect", pattern]
    for pattern in forbids:
        argv += ["--forbid", pattern]
    argv += ["--"] + command
    proc = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(("PASS " if proc.returncode == 0 else "FAIL ") + name)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
